# Foundry rule index

Severity values are the catalogue values (error, warning, info). Rule files carry the prod value as the PSRule level; the baselines in `baselines/` override it per profile. Mapping: error = Error, warning = Warning, info = Information.

Status `evaluated-subset`: PSRule evaluates the subset of the catalogue evidence listed on the rule page. Status `not-evaluated`: the rule exists but never runs and never reports Pass; see `not-evaluated.md`.
